en: Colorized historical postcard view of a street corner with a prominent three‑story neoclassical stone building and people walking or with carts on a broad unpaved street. The building has ornate window frames, a small pediment with relief decoration, and signs above the ground floor. Trees and smaller buildings line the side streets. Printed titling in German appears in the upper right corner and on the facade of the building.
